primitives.name: Higgsfield Visual Asset Generation
primitives.verbatim_quote: # asset-system — the Higgsfield-generated visual system (Phase 2) The whole point of this skill: sites built here look expensive because **as much of the visual layer as possible is bespoke-generated on Higgsfield** — not stock, not icon fonts, not CSS approximations.
primitives.assumptions: Assumes a pre-defined design board (palette, mood, narrative spine) and user-provided assets take precedence over generated ones.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singular behavior occurs when user-provided assets clash with the chosen direction, requiring manual intervention.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI's conformal predictive sets for visual assets, treating each generated image as a multivariate prediction interval. Maps to GSE's state-transition logic by framing asset generation as a sequential decision problem under uncertainty.
layer2.telemetry: Average completion time per job type, success rate of prompt adherence, and user satisfaction scores.

primitives.name: Async Command Submission Protocol
primitives.verbatim_quote: Commands (all async — submit everything up front with `higgsfield generate create <job_type> ...` WITHOUT `--wait` so each returns a job id, build while rendering, poll `higgsfield generate wait <id>` / `higgsfield generate get <id>`).
primitives.assumptions: Assumes network connectivity and that the Higgsfield API can handle concurrent asynchronous requests.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singular behavior occurs when the API rate limits are exceeded, causing command queuing delays.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI's sequential testing framework for evaluating command pipelines. Maps to GSE's Markov decision process by modeling the state transitions between command submission and polling.
layer2.telemetry: API request latency, queue depth, and successful job completion rates.

primitives.name: Brand Asset Kit Synthesis
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## The asset kit (generate per tier; palette-locked to the boards) **Precedence rule: the user's own assets always win.** Anything the user provides (logo, brand marks, product photos, team photos, fonts, existing icon set) is used as-is — never regenerate a replacement for something they gave you.
primitives.assumptions: Assumes the user's provided assets are in a usable format and meet quality thresholds.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singular behavior occurs when user assets are corrupted or incompatible with the synthesis pipeline.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI's Bayesian model averaging over asset candidates. Maps to GSE's reinforcement learning by treating asset selection as a reward maximization problem.
layer2.telemetry: Asset consistency score, regeneration frequency, and user override rate.

primitives.name: Canvas Image Sequence Renderer
primitives.verbatim_quote: Fictional project/product UIs are generated as images (never div-built fakes).
primitives.assumptions: Assumes browser support for canvas rendering and efficient memory management for streaming image sequences.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singular behavior occurs when the image sequence exceeds memory limits, causing rendering artifacts or crashes.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI's time-series forecasting for predicting rendering performance. Maps to GSE's finite-state automaton by modeling the rendering pipeline as a state machine with transitions between preloading and streaming.
layer2.telemetry: Frame rate stability, memory usage, and error occurrence during rendering.

reasoning_traces.think:
The core challenge is transforming abstract design boards into concrete, high-fidelity visual assets while respecting user-preferred content. This requires a robust probabilistic framework to map uncertain design inputs (mood boards, palettes) to deterministic outputs (images, videos). The async command protocol enables parallel processing, reducing end-to-end generation time. The asset kit synthesis prioritizes user agency, treating their contributions as hard constraints. Finally, the canvas renderer bridges the gap between generated media and interactive web experiences, ensuring smooth playback. Together, these primitives form a compositional operator that maps high-level design intent to low-level pixel data, with verification metrics tracking adherence to design specifications and computational efficiency.
